obligations.text: Every command, option value, exit code, schema identifier and output path the README names exists in the source; a surface the live runtime does not implement is stated as not implemented.
The README carries no engine pin chronology, setup-profile revision history or commit identities; it links to the specs and the dated audit that hold them.
docs/reference holds exactly the pages spec-spine reference generate writes for the committed corpus, and scripts/reference.sh check passes.
The README usage block matches the executable's usage text, the reference check passes, and the gate passes.

sectionHeadings: 020: The README is a user guide and reference pages are generated from the specs
record.summary: Rewrites README.md as a user-facing guide (what wire-witness does, status, install, usage, exit codes, output schemas, workspace, documentation map, development) and moves toolchain and governance chronology out of it. Adds one generated spec-spine reference page per spec under docs/reference, with a repository-owned script that regenerates or checks them.
